name: aws_lb
description: Provides an Application Load Balancer (ALB) resource. ALB operates at Layer 7 of the OSI model and routes HTTP/HTTPS traffic based on content-based routing rules. It integrates with ECS, EKS, and EC2 and supports SSL termination, WebSocket, and HTTP/2.
use_cases: Distribute incoming HTTP/HTTPS traffic to ECS tasks or EKS pods
SSL/TLS termination at the load balancer level
Blue/green and canary deployments via weighted target groups

optional.name: name
optional.description: Name of the load balancer. Must be unique within a region and account (max 32 characters).

optional.name: internal
optional.description: If true, creates an internal (private) load balancer. Default: false (internet-facing).

optional.name: security_groups
optional.description: List of security group IDs for the ALB. Only valid for application type.

optional.name: subnets
optional.description: List of subnet IDs. ALB requires subnets in at least 2 AZs.

optional.name: enable_deletion_protection
optional.description: Enable deletion protection. Recommended: true in production.

optional.name: drop_invalid_header_fields
optional.description: Drop invalid HTTP header fields. Recommended: true for security.

optional.name: tags
optional.description: Map of tags to assign to the load balancer.

best_practices: Always redirect HTTP to HTTPS — never serve unencrypted traffic in production
Use TLS 1.3 SSL policy (ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06) for security
Enable access logs to S3 for security auditing and debugging
Use drop_invalid_header_fields = true to prevent header injection attacks
Set health check path to a lightweight endpoint (/health or /ping)
Use target_type = 'ip' for Fargate and EKS pod direct routing
Configure deregistration delay appropriately (30s for fast-draining services)
security_notes: Use HTTPS-only listeners with strong TLS policies
Restrict ALB security group to only ports 80 and 443 from 0.0.0.0/0
Use ACM (AWS Certificate Manager) for free SSL/TLS certificates
Enable access logging for compliance and incident investigation

common_errors.error: ALB requires subnets in at least 2 different Availability Zones
common_errors.fix: Provide subnets from at least 2 different AZs in the subnets argument

common_errors.error: Health check failures causing 0 healthy targets
common_errors.fix: Verify the health check path returns 200 and is accessible from ALB security group. Check container startup time vs health check interval
